'''Elansu''' is the ''[[shatayan]]'' of the [[Fal Dara]] keep in [[Shienar]].

==History==
Like most ''shatayan'', she enjoys high status and does not expect to be spoken against from anyone, including [[Agelmar Jagad|the lord she serves]].

Her male counterpart and supposed equal, [[Ronan]] the ''[[shambayan]]'', is old and slightly frail, further increasing her level of authority.

==Appearance==
She has a stern face and black hair. Although never stated, it is likely that her hair is drawn back in a bun to emphasize her authority.

==Activities==
She informs [[Rand al'Thor]] of the new clothes that have been made for him on [[Moiraine Sedai]]'s orders. She is as amused as any other woman in the keep at Rand's embarrassment for the free-spirited Shienaran customs.{{ref/book|2|2}}
